attributes.action: No PCN charges for all Thames crossings. Only an additional fee for a reminder.
attributes.additional_details: Thames crossings charge tolls to fund operational costs. These are managed by London Transport. Users shouldn't pay penalties if they fail to pay the charge within 48 hours, as it is unintentional and no driving offence has been committed, users should be charged a maximum £20 administration fee if they have failed to pay, not an £80 penalty. All Crossings over water should not charge Penalties in the UK. The road network brings the nation together and shouldn't be exploited by Authorties.
attributes.background: All Users of Thames Crossings, wether its Blackwall, Silvertown or Dartford crossing. Should not pay penalties if users have failed to pay within 48 hours. An additional administration fee of maximum £20 should be charged not a £80 penalty. Users don't intentionally fail to pay the charge.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for. Decisions about charges for Blackwall and Silvertown tunnels are a matter for Transport for London, not the UK Government or Parliament.

Although the Dartford Crossing is the responsibility of the UK Government, we can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level (in this case, relating to a particular bridge). 

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
